title: Phase Estimation of the T Gate (Core of Shor's Algorithm)
caption: Quantum phase estimation with three counting qubits (q0–q2) and target q3 prepared in the eigenstate |1⟩ of T. The counting qubits control T, T² = S, and T⁴ = Z, followed by the inverse QFT. Since T has eigenphase 1/8 = 0.001 in binary, measuring q0 q1 q2 yields 001 with probability 1.
